title: Knight Armor and Weapons
description: This mod adds Knight Armor and Weapons to Minecraft.
body:
This mod adds Knight Armor and Weapons to Minecraft.

Features:

- Knight Armor
- Long Sword (more range)
- Hand Scythe (multi target)
- Spiked Mace (penetrates armor and shields)
- Throwing Axe (with a chance to break on impact, can be repaired)
